description:
*** VIRTUAL TOUR AVAILABLE ***

West Winds is an impressive four-bedroom, fully detached family home, ideally positioned in the highly regarded Raheen area of Athenry. Offering generous accommodation, excellent outdoor space and a superb range of amenities close by, this property presents an excellent opportunity for families, first-time buyers or those seeking a comfortable home within easy reach of Galway City.
* Site with Full Planning Permission adjacent to residence, also for sale. AMV €150,000 

One of the standout features of West Winds is the beautifully landscaped gardens, providing a wonderful outdoor setting. The property is also accompanied by a large garage and two separate sheds, providing an abundance of valuable storage.

The location is particularly appealing, with Athenry town centre and its wide range of everyday amenities within easy reach. Local facilities include primary and secondary schools, childcare services, shops, supermarkets, pharmacies, medical facilities, cafés, restaurants and a variety of sporting and recreational clubs. Athenry also benefits from an excellent rail service, with up on twenty daily connections to Galway and other destinations, making it an attractive choice for commuters.

For families, the combination of generous accommodation, landscaped gardens, extensive storage and proximity to schools and community facilities makes West Winds an especially attractive proposition. For commuters, the excellent road and rail connections provide convenient access to Galway City and beyond.

With its combination of space, privacy, practical outdoor facilities and an enviable location, West Winds is a home that offers both comfort and convenience in the heart of Athenry.

Features:
- Comprising of a c. 1,930sq, ft of living space
-4 Bedrooms with an additional flexible room suitable for a home office, gym or playroom
-Oil fired central heating
-Within 5 minute walking distance to train station and town centre
-Excellent public transportation links and motorway access
-Schools nearby
-Mature landscaped gardens
-Site with FPP next door  also available.
